comment: Sensor capability manifest + policy for the S10+ (beyond2lte). Read by tools/s10plus/a33/nuxel-sensors-diag.sh. What the device ACTUALLY exposes is enumerated from three independent sources (IIO devices, the input subsystem, and the sensor-hub driver set) and reported per class. The `expected_on_s10plus` flags below are the device's documented hardware, NOT observations: a class is only `readable` when a real raw value is read, otherwise it is `present-unreadable`, and when nothing is enumerated it is `NOT_SUPPORTED_ON_DEVICE`. Motion/orientation must be physically induced, so the terminal verdict is NEEDS_OWNER_TEST.

evidence_sources.comment_hub_input: The A32 baseline observed these input devices on the handset (grip_sensor, ssp_context, hall, certify_hall). They are hub evidence for the sensor-group as a whole, so a class with no IIO node is still PRESENT_UNREADABLE rather than absent.

accelerometer.owner_gesture: tilt the phone left/right and forward/back — the axis values must change and settle

gyroscope.owner_gesture: rotate the phone about each axis — the rate values must change and return to ~0 when still

magnetometer.owner_gesture: rotate the phone through a full turn — the field values must change and the heading must respond

proximity.owner_gesture: cover the top of the screen with your hand — near/far must flip

ambient_light.owner_gesture: move from a dark corner to a lit area — the lux value must rise and fall

barometer.owner_gesture: change altitude slightly (stairs/lift) — the pressure value must move; a static value is unproven, not PASS

heart_rate.owner_gesture: place a finger on the rear sensor for 20 s — a plausible rate (40..200 bpm) must appear

grip.owner_gesture: cover the side grip area — the grip input must change

hall.owner_gesture: bring a magnet near the top-left of the phone (or close a flip cover) — the hall input must flip

verdicts.READABLE_SOME: at least one class returned a raw value; the rest are enumerated/absent as printed
verdicts.PRESENT_UNREADABLE: classes are enumerated (input/hub) but expose no readable raw value
verdicts.BLOCKED_KERNEL: nothing is enumerated from IIO, input or the hub drivers
verdicts.NOT_SUPPORTED_ON_DEVICE: a specific class has no evidence anywhere (per-class state)
